title: How to generate monthly income from investments in Canada
summary: Most investing conversations focus on whether a portfolio is up or down. Monthly income investing adds another question: is the portfolio producing cash flow along the way? For Canadians, that cash flow can come from different types of investments, including ETFs that pay monthly distributions, dividend-paying stocks, bonds, GICs, interest-bearing products, and other income-focused funds. Some investors use the income. Some reinvest it. Others simply want to understand what their portfolio could produce over time. This guide explains how monthly income from investments works, what types of investments may generate it, how monthly income ETFs work, and what to review before investing.
